text: Confirmed and filed #6578 (open, owner-authored, agent-approved): GOTO TOP with a SET FILTER callback that closes/reopens the source cursor faults Copperfin with “out of memory” at the command. A non-mutating callback control passes; installed VFP9 SP2 COM returns 1099 Procedure canceled instead. This is the synchronous visibility seeker path, distinct from SCAN #6576 and LOCATE #6577. VFP SET FILTER/GO reference and exact local/VM probes are linked in the issue; no production changes.
